g.text: Assessment lifecycle at the hub (state machine, supplier_hub/domain/state_machine.py)
stays at the hub only, visible to
nothing is written to the node
Manual resolve (MANUAL) is allowed from every open state except ASSESSING.
Assignee (PUT /assessments/{id}/assignee) can change in any state: event ASSIGNED, no transition.
identifier_evidence = SAME_TRADE_ITEM ends the round immediately: EQUIVALENT into PROPOSED_RESOLUTION, no comparators and no judge call.
send-questions answers 409 while PURCHASER questions are DRAFT or SENT, or attribute proposals are PENDING.
The current template definition is used each round; the round stores the definition it judged in input_snapshot (D52).
Every transition goes through the state machine table, writes an events row,
and increments assessments.version (optimistic locking, 409 on conflict).
Stop conditions: decisive verdict | round_no >= max_rounds (3) |
all blocking gaps UNAVAILABLE or none left that can be asked (BLOCKING_UNAVAILABLE).
The judge is not called when a critical attribute already mismatches.
retry is allowed only from FAILED; extra round raises max_rounds by one.
purchaser questions answered at the node
